lead.headline: Vermont and UMass Lowell lead a close league
lead.deck: The Catamounts rate highest in America East at 174th. The River Hawks sit six spots behind.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers America East, nine schools from Orono, Burlington and Durham down to Binghamton, Newark and Baltimore. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Vermont (174th) is 2-2. The Catamounts lost 56-55 at Iona and 79-76 at home to Quinnipiac, and won 79-67 at Fairfield.
UMass Lowell (180th) is 3-1. The River Hawks won 71-61 at Merrimack, beat Marist 63-61 and lost 72-62 at UMass.
New Hampshire is also 3-1, with road wins at Brown and Rider and an 81-76 overtime loss to Sacred Heart.
Binghamton won 58-55 at Saint Peter's and is 3-2.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **8.** America East games decided by three points or fewer, from Vermont's one-point loss at Iona to NJIT's 54-52 win over Saint Peter's.
**121.** UMass Lowell's points against Rivier, the league's high.
**2.** America East teams in our national top 200, Vermont and UMass Lowell.

notes.headline: UMBC splits the week
notes.body: The Retrievers beat Morgan State 85-70, then scored 42 in a 68-42 loss at Towson, the league's lowest total so far.

notes.headline: NJIT's first win
notes.body: The Highlanders are 1-5. The win was 54-52 over Saint Peter's.

notes.headline: Maine by two, both ways
notes.body: The Black Bears won 74-72 at Sacred Heart and lost 66-64 at home to Drexel.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The America East tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
